scenes.title: The Transformation Engine
scenes.description: Visualize PublAI's content transformation as a neural network diagram. Raw inputs (text, image, video, audio) flow through AI processing layers (Analyze, Compose, Optimize) and emerge as cinematic, branded, engaging output.
visual_elements: Input nodes (gray) for raw content types
Processing nodes (green) for AI engine steps
Output nodes (bright green) for transformed content
Animated data flow particles along connections
animations: Staggered node appearance with spring physics
Connection lines fade in between layers
Data flow particles travel along paths
scenes.continuity_out: Full network visible with flowing data particles
